topology.title: Topology Space Adventure
topology.subtitle: Where stretching is legal and cutting is a space crime

buttons.ready: Ready for the Rubber Rule test!

rule.title: The Rubber Rule
rule.intro: 👽 **Welcome aboard, earthling!** Captain Zorb here. In space, shapes are made of super-rubber. You may STRETCH them, SQUISH them, BEND them — and they stay the same shape! But cutting? Poking new holes? Gluing? FORBIDDEN — that would really change them. Play with Gloop 🐙, then take the Rubber Rule test!
rule.quizPrompt: Does the Rubber Rule allow this move?
rule.retry: Hmm — does the shape stay in one piece, with the same holes?
rule.retryHint2: The rule: stretching, squishing and bending are fine. Cutting, poking holes and gluing are NOT.
rule.done: You know the Rubber Rule! Now for the strangest machine in the port… 🌟

morph.title: The Mug Machine
morph.intro: ☕ **The famous Mug Machine!** Zorb drops a coffee mug inside and stretches it — never cutting, never poking. Watch closely at every step and count the holes. Something amazing is about to be true…
morph.holesPrompt: How many holes does it have right now?

stages.s0: A coffee mug. The inside of the cup is a DENT — only the handle goes all the way through.
stages.s1: Squish! The cup gets shallower… the hole doesn't care.
stages.s2: The cup part melted into the handle — still one hole.
stages.s3: Almost round now. The hole rides along.

morph.punchline: One hole the whole way. A mug IS a donut! ☕≈🍩
morph.retry: Can you poke your finger all the way THROUGH it? The cup's inside is a dent, not a hole — only the handle counts!
morph.retryHint2: The glowing ring marks the real hole. The grey ✕ is just a dent.
morph.done: Stretching never changes the number of holes — that's the great secret of topology! 🌟

cargo.title: The Cargo Bay
cargo.intro: 📦 **Cargo inspection!** Every item in the Space Port gets sorted by its most important feature: how many holes go ALL the way through. Not dents, not pockets — real tunnels. Sort the cargo into the right crate!
cargo.prompt: How many holes go all the way through?
cargo.retry: Poke your finger through — how many tunnels does it have?
cargo.retryHint2: Remember: a pocket or a dent is NOT a hole. Only tunnels that go all the way through count!
cargo.done: You can count what stretching can never erase. The cargo bay is spotless! 📦

customs.title: Alien Customs
customs.intro: 🤖 **Officer Beep checks every traveler.** Two shapes are secretly THE SAME if super-rubber could stretch one into the other — and that works exactly when they have the same number of holes! Stamp each pair: same shape, or different?
customs.prompt: Could one stretch into the other — without cutting or poking?
customs.retry: Count each one's holes first — then compare!
customs.retryHint2: Same number of holes = same shape. Different number = no stretching can ever fix that.
customs.done: Officer Beep salutes you: you see what shapes secretly are! 🤖

license.title: The Shape-Shifter License
license.intro: 🪪 **The final ceremony!** Answer Captain Zorb's four questions — one from each station — and earn your official Shape-Shifter License, stamped and starry.

q.move: Which of these moves is FORBIDDEN by the Rubber Rule?
q.holes: How many holes does a life buoy 🛟 have?
q.same: A mug and a ring 💍 — same shape?
q.morph: Which of these could a donut 🍩 stretch into?

license.licenseLine: Certified by the Space Port Kingdom — may stretch, squish and bend anywhere in the galaxy.
license.retry: Think back to the stations you visited…
license.done: License granted! The whole galaxy of shapes is yours to bend. 🪪✨

skills.rule: I know the rubber rule: stretch and bend — never cut or poke
skills.morph: I watched a mug become a donut — the hole survived the whole way
skills.holes: Holes are what stretching can never erase — I can count them
skills.same: Two shapes are secretly the same when their holes match

topology.finished: You discovered two great secrets: stretching and bending never really change a shape — and the holes are the one thing no stretching can erase. A mug is a donut, scissors are eyeglasses, and the universe is bendier than it looks. 🚀✨
